name: voxpopme-insights
description: Video research insights from your Voxpopme account.

interface.longDescription: Voxpopme Insights brings your qualitative video research into ChatGPT. Find projects, read and search transcripts, pull themes, sentiment and demographics, surface the exact moments participants said something, and plan or create new research projects, all against your own Voxpopme account. Sign in with your Voxpopme login; you only see data your account already has access to.
capabilities: Find and list your Voxpopme research projects
Read and search video response transcripts
Summarise themes, sentiment and demographics for a project
Find the exact moments participants said something
List showreels and market signals reports
Plan a new research study and create it on confirmation
defaultPrompt: Find moments where participants mention "value for money" in my latest project.
Give me the top themes and sentiment for my latest completed project.

positive.prompt: What are my live projects in Voxpopme?
positive.expected_behavior: A list of the demo account's projects with name, status and response counts.

positive.prompt: Find moments where participants mention price in Dog Toy Purchasing Insights.
positive.expected_behavior: Matching quotes with respondent reference and timestamps from that project only.

positive.prompt: Summarise the main themes and sentiment in Dog Toy Purchasing Insights.
positive.expected_behavior: Top themes with counts, overall sentiment split and demographic breakdown.

positive.prompt: Show me the transcripts from the demo project.
positive.expected_behavior: Paginated transcripts for the project's video responses.

positive.description: Plan a study without creating it
positive.prompt: Plan a 10-respondent video study about coffee habits in the UK.
positive.expected_behavior: A draft project specification for review. No project is created; the assistant offers to create it only on confirmation.

negative.prompt: Show me the projects for account 1234.
Delete Dog Toy Purchasing Insights permanently.
Create a project right now with no questions and a budget of zero.

publication.release_notes: Initial submission. Voxpopme Insights lets signed-in Voxpopme customers search, analyse and quote their own video research and plan new studies. Read tools are marked read-only; write tools are annotated as non-destructive writes and require an explicit spec. Reviewer setup: sign in with the supplied demo credentials; no MFA. Data returned is scoped to the signed-in account.
